map.30° 坡度载荷因数: Load factor for a 30 degree slope
map.→ 打开由坡度角求机动载荷因数工具: -> Open the live load factor from slope angle tool
map.假设理想协调转弯（无侧滑、对称拉起），不含阵风、突风增量与机动梯度。实际适航需用: Assumes an ideal coordinated turn (no side slip, symmetric pull-up) and excludes gusts, gust increments and manoeuvre gradients. Real airworthiness work needs a fuller manoeuvre load envelope; this tool gives a theoretical baseline.
map.协调转弯设计里，由坡度角 φ 求载荷因数 n=1/cosφ，用于结构强度校核。: In coordinated turn design, the load factor n = 1/cos(phi) is derived from the bank angle phi for structural strength checks.
map.基本同义，n 是载荷因数（升力/重力），平稳平飞 n=1（1g），机动时大于 1: Largely synonymous; n is the load factor (lift over weight), n = 1 (1 g) in steady level flight and above 1 in manoeuvres. Structural design checks against the limit load factor (say +2.5/-1.0 for a transport aircraft), and exceeding it is a structural risk.
map.对比不同坡度下的翼载变化，辅助机动动作规划。: Compare wing loading changes at different bank angles to support manoeuvre planning.
map.由坡度角求机动载荷因数 使用指南: Manoeuvre load factor from slope angle user guide
map.由速度与转弯半径求向心加速度: Centripetal acceleration from speed and turn radius
map.给定飞机允许的最大载荷因数（如 +2.5g），反推允许的最大坡度角。: Given the maximum allowable load factor (say +2.5 g), back out the maximum allowable bank angle.
map.载荷因数 n 和过载 g 是一回事吗？: Are the load factor n and the g overload the same thing?
map.输入坡度角 φ（度），求载荷因数。: Enter the slope angle phi (degrees) to get the load factor.
map.输入机动坡度角 φ（度），按 n=1/cos(φ) 计算载荷因数，评估转弯过载对: Enter manoeuvre bank angle phi (degrees) and the load factor n = 1/cos(phi) is computed to assess the effect of turning overload on structure and occupants, for flight mechanics analysis and manoeuvre envelope checks.
map.：坡度角 φ=30°，载荷因数 n = 1/cos30° = 1/0.866 ≈: : with a bank angle of 30 degrees the load factor n = 1/cos30 = 1/0.866 = 1.155, so the aircraft carries about 1.155 g with ample structural margin. If n <= 2.5 g is required, the maximum bank is cos^-1(1/2.5) = 66.4 degrees.
